basics.name: Pablo Alberto Santana Flores
basics.label: Chemical Data Specialist & QA Engineer
basics.summary: Chemical Engineer, Data Scientist, and PhD Candidate in Marine Sciences, with 16+ years of expertise in quality assurance, analytical chemistry, and precision instrumentation. Currently excelling as a Chemistry & Lab Data Specialist at TELUS Digital, validating AI-generated molecular structures and refining safety protocols. Holds an M.Sc. in Sciences, alongside advanced certifications in Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence, and HACCP compliance. A highly adaptable, detail-oriented professional with a proven track record in cross-functional collaboration and international mobility, bridging the gap between raw chemical data and automated technological solutions.

work.name: TELUS Digital
highlights: Validate AI-generated chemical formulas and molecular structures for accuracy and compliance.
Audit and refine safety protocols for automated chemical recommendations.
Structure and manage complex experimental datasets to optimize machine learning model training.
Translate advanced chemical concepts into accessible insights for non-technical stakeholders.
